_comment: Questions a BVTU member would actually type, each with the article that should be found. 'expect' matches against the document title, case-insensitively; any one of the listed strings counts. Used by tools/ca-eval.php. Add to it whenever a member asks something the assistant gets wrong — that is what makes the next change measurable.
